title: Tsuchiyu kokeshi
summary: Turn a slim wooden doll with a long neck and a big round head, paint a red band, then add its eyes and mouth under a red dotted hair band.
howToPlay: Match the doll in the frame.
Drag across each row of wood to set its width.
Tap the bands to paint them.
Press Paint face, then tap each glowing mark.
rules: The neck is the narrowest part and the head the widest.
Shape counts for 55 of the 100 points: how closely each row of the doll matches the lit outline.
The bands count for 25 points: each band must be the right colour.
The finishing touches count for 20 points: tap every glowing mark to paint it.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn paints a whole doll for you.
heritageNote: Tsuchiyu kokeshi come from a hot-spring village in Fukushima. They are known for a long neck, a large round head, a red dotted hair band and rings of red and blue on a slim body.
